title: Echoes in the Loop: Diagnosing Risks in LLM-Powered Recommender Systems under Feedback Loops

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the 'popularity gap' by computing the difference between the average popularity score (historical interaction counts) of LLM-recommended items and the items actually consumed by users in the ground truth, and tracking this gap across simulated feedback loops.

Comparing the frequency distribution of LLM-inferred gender attributes in generated user profiles against the empirical ground-truth distributions to detect bias amplification (e.g., an inflated proportion of male users).
Analyzing the frequency distribution of LLM-inferred age groups compared to actual ground-truth age distributions to identify systematic skews or imbalances.

Evaluating the distribution of LLM-generated user occupations against real ground-truth data to detect distributional shifts and the over-representation of specific or domain-specific occupations (e.g., 'film critic').
Examining the frequency distributions of genres and categories in LLM-augmented item interactions to identify disproportionate skews toward a narrow subset of popular genres and categories.
